I told Pree in a thread reply on her message in #central-random that the ticket is #8841.

The source is Tobias's message in that same channel yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27). He said West yard Door 2 at the Plains depots was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on ticket #8841 for support. He didn't name Marrow Fieldworks outright. He was answering Hollis about "Tobias's dealer account", and Tobias has owned Marrow Fieldworks since January. Because of that small gap, I suggested Pree confirm the number with Tobias before she uses it on the customer call.

I didn't find a ticket file for this. The shared file folders came back empty for me.
